have hσa := (hpc j i).joinedIn x ⟨hx j, hx i⟩ a ⟨hα α.target_mem_range, hδ δ.source_mem_range⟩
  have hσb := (hpc i k).joinedIn x ⟨hx i, hx k⟩ b ⟨hδ δ.target_mem_range, hβ β.target_mem_range⟩
  have hσa' : range hσa.somePath ⊆ U j ∩ U i := range_subset_iff.2 hσa.somePath_mem
  have hσb' : range hσb.somePath ⊆ U i ∩ U k := range_subset_iff.2 hσb.somePath_mem
  set σa := _root_.FundamentalGroupoid.fromPath ⟦hσa.somePath⟧
  set σb := _root_.FundamentalGroupoid.fromPath ⟦hσb.somePath⟧
  have hsplit : _root_.FundamentalGroupoid.fromPath ⟦α⟧ ≫
      _root_.FundamentalGroupoid.fromPath ⟦δ⟧ ≫ inv (_root_.FundamentalGroupoid.fromPath ⟦β⟧) =
      (_root_.FundamentalGroupoid.fromPath ⟦α⟧ ≫ inv σa) ≫
        (σa ≫ _root_.FundamentalGroupoid.fromPath ⟦δ⟧ ≫ inv σb) ≫
        (σb ≫ inv (_root_.FundamentalGroupoid.fromPath ⟦β⟧)) := by
    simp
  have hmid : (End.of (σa ≫ _root_.FundamentalGroupoid.fromPath ⟦δ⟧ ≫ inv σb) :
      _root_.FundamentalGroup X x) ∈ H := by
    rw [← Groupoid.inv_eq_inv]
    refine fromPath_mem_iSup_range hx (i := i) (hσa.somePath.trans (δ.trans hσb.somePath.symm)) ?_
    rw [Path.trans_range, Path.trans_range, Path.symm_range]
    exact union_subset (hσa'.trans inter_subset_right)
      (union_subset hδ (hσb'.trans inter_subset_left))
  rw [hsplit]
  -- In `End`, `f ≫ g` is the product `g * f`.
  exact H.mul_mem (H.mul_mem (comp_inv_mem_iSup_range hx _ _ (hσb'.trans inter_subset_right) hβ)
    hmid) (comp_inv_mem_iSup_range hx _ _ hα (hσa'.trans inter_subset_left))
